RegionBehavior.dc-npc-patrols.dcDialogTree: Opens a branching conversation when a player enters the region.
RegionBehavior.dc-npc-patrols.dcAmbient: Whispers a random flavour line when a player enters the region.
RegionBehavior.dc-npc-patrols.dcTerrainCost: Assigns a movement cost multiplier to terrain. NPCs will prefer cheaper routes when alternatives exist.

enable_patrols.name: Enable NPC Behaviour Trees
enable_patrols.hint: Master toggle for BT ticking. When off, NPCs stand still regardless of assigned trees.

proximity_radius.name: Default Proximity Radius
proximity_radius.hint: Default radius in grid squares for auto-generated proximity regions around NPCs.

ambient_cooldown.name: Ambient Dialog Cooldown
ambient_cooldown.hint: Seconds before an NPC repeats ambient dialog to the same player.

combat_freeze.name: Freeze NPCs in Combat
combat_freeze.hint: When enabled, NPCs stop moving during combat (unless their behaviour tree handles combat turns).

bt_tick_interval_ms.name: Behaviour Tree Tick Interval (ms)
bt_tick_interval_ms.hint: How often the GM client ticks NPC behaviour trees. Lower values react faster; higher values reduce CPU use.

bt_combat_debug.name: BT Combat Debug
bt_combat_debug.hint: Show GM notifications when combat behaviour trees fail or skip a turn.

bt_debug.name: BT Debug Logging
bt_debug.hint: Enable verbose console logging for the behaviour tree engine — tick lifecycle, NPC skip reasons, node dispatch and status, and combat passes. Useful for diagnosing ticks not firing. Output is prefixed [dc-npc-patrols|bt:].

nav_resolution.name: Pathfinding Resolution
nav_resolution.hint: Subdivides each grid square into N×N navigation cells for finer wall avoidance. 1 = original behavior, 4 = recommended for tight corridors. Higher values improve pathfinding in narrow spaces but use more memory.

npc_door_sounds.name: NPC Door Sounds
npc_door_sounds.hint: Play Foundry door open/close sounds when NPCs use doors during pathfinding or door interact actions. Off by default to avoid noise with many NPCs.

block_tokens.name: Block Tokens in Pathfinding
block_tokens.hint: Treat other tokens' footprints as obstacles during A* pathfinding so NPCs route around them instead of walking through. Also prevents multiple NPCs from selecting the same destination tile.

chat_bubble_scale.name: Chat Bubble Scale
chat_bubble_scale.hint: Enlarge chat bubbles on the canvas so NPC dialog and ambient lines are easier to read. 100% is the Foundry default; 300% is 3× larger. Text is also darkened for better contrast.

nodes.equip_item: Equips or unequips gear matched by partial item label.
nodes.use_item: Fires on_use boons for a usable inventory item (not attacks).
nodes.update_visible_tokens: Scans Foundry token vision and writes a list of visible tokens to the blackboard.
nodes.visible_tokens: Checks whether enough visible tokens match on the blackboard (optionally refreshes first).
nodes.acquire_target: Finds the closest matching token and stores it on the blackboard.
nodes.measure_range: Measures distance to a blackboard target and stores it as {target_key}_range.
nodes.fire_weapon: Fires the equipped weapon at a blackboard target through Deadlands combat.
nodes.reload_weapon: Reloads the equipped weapon using Deadlands ammo rules.
nodes.modify_item: Adds or removes inventory items by partial label.
nodes.wander_region: Walks to a random reachable point inside a named region.
nodes.range: Compares distance to a blackboard target against a threshold.
nodes.variable: Checks a tree template variable resolved for this NPC.
nodes.set_token_image: Sets, restores, or resets the token texture for visual state changes.
nodes.fire_boons: Fires a list of Deadlands boons (damage, healing, statuses, teleport, pool/trait/skill changes, roll gates, etc.) against the NPC or a blackboard target.
nodes.roll_gate: Runs a Deadlands skill/trait/formula check (with fate chip dialog) and branches on the result.
nodes.set_blackboard: Writes a key/value onto the NPC's blackboard so the tree can remember state across ticks.
nodes.teleport: Instantly teleports the NPC or a blackboard target token to a named region.
nodes.blackboard: Checks a value on the NPC's blackboard against an operator.

condition_character.description: Checks character pools, traits, skills, gear, flags, edges, equipment, statuses, or scalar stats.

condition_light.description: Checks scene, campaign, or position darkness, or whether the token is lit.
